metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Overlay (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Visual Layer for RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative overlay projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Overlay is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, alignments, context, and log.

rtt_node.label: Current RTT Node
rtt_node.notes: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.

regime.label: Current Regime
regime.notes: Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

operator.label: Active Operator
operator.notes: Operator MUST match current RTT node.

paradox.label: Paradox Events
paradox.notes: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.

projection_rules: Overlay MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.
Overlay MUST NOT invent measure values.
Overlay MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Overlay MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be nominal, harmonic, or resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.

non_claims: Overlay does not revise RTT v0.9.
Overlay does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Overlay does not replace the human FFT book.
